prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, logo-brand.
Edit the attached ECG-to-runner logo concept into a MUCH MORE MINIMAL final app logo. The attached image is a conceptual reference for the idea only; radically simplify its construction.
Keep the idea: an ECG line on the left transforms into a running person at the center and becomes an ECG line again on the right.
Crucial simplification: REMOVE the anatomical body OUTLINE and ALL doubled limb contours. Draw the runner as an extremely spare single-line stick-figure gesture, not an outlined silhouette. A small simple circular head, one straight leaning torso, two angular legs, and only ONE clearly visible bent arm. No internal details. Every limb is represented by ONE line, never a tubular outline. Prefer about five decisive strokes for the entire figure. A detached circular head is allowed for better simplicity.
The runner is active, moving to the right: head ahead of the shoulders, torso tilted forward, front knee bent and raised, rear leg extending back. Clear generous gaps separate the limbs.
The left and right ECG traces are very short and join the runner's lower limbs naturally. Each side has just ONE basic sharp up-down zigzag and a short flat terminal. Remove all smaller P/T-wave bumps and long horizontal tails. No uninterrupted line passing behind the figure. The whole composition is compact, about 1.5:1, with the runner dominating and the two tiny ECG gestures as secondary accents.
Use one consistent substantial monoline thickness, approximately 36px in a 1024px canvas, perfectly smooth rounded ends and rounded joints. This must still read clearly as a running person at a 48px application icon size.
Color: a restrained smooth linear gradient across the STROKES ONLY, from cyan #20D8F8 on the left to blue #2F7EF6 on the right. All strokes share this same one coherent gradient. No white, no black, no extra colors, no glow, no shadow, no lighting, no texture or bevel.
Square 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Center the symbol with generous optically balanced clear space; artwork occupies about 72% of canvas width. True RGBA transparency everywhere outside the gradient strokes, including inner spaces. No colored rectangle, no app-icon tile, no checkerboard baked in.
Absolutely NO lettering, words, initials, numbers, slogans, extra symbols, captions, border, grid or watermark. Output exactly one flat refined compact symbol, ready to serve as the primary logo of a premium health and smart-footwear app.
